CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.accepted_type:

  0 < x 0 →
    0 < y 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
        CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x +
            CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y +
          (γ - 1) / 2 * CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.weight y x *
            CFDLean.squareSum fun i => CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i
